median-even-length.new:
middle = len(ordered) // 2
    if len(ordered) % 2:
        return ordered[middle]
    return (ordered[middle - 1] + ordered[middle]) / 2

query-encoding.old: return "&".join(f"{key}={quote(value)}" for key, value in params.items())

filename-final-extension.new:
stem, suffix = filename.rsplit(".", 1)
    return suffix.lower() if stem else ""
